description: This file defines the MyLeaveRequestAPI class in the OrangeHRM system, which provides API endpoints for managing an employee's leave requests, including fetching, creating, and updating leave request data within the HRM system.

classes.name: MyLeaveRequestAPI
classes.description: API class for managing employee leave requests, including retrieval, creation, updating, and permission checks, extending base leave request APIs.

methods.name: getLeaveApplicationService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of LeaveApplicationService used for applying and managing leave requests.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific leave request details, supporting detailed or default models, inherits behavior from parent class.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Fetches a list of leave requests for the authenticated employee, with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new leave request for the authenticated employee, handling different response models.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing leave request, such as approving, rejecting, or canceling, inheriting behavior from parent class.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Not implemented, throws a 'Not Implemented' exception.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'getAll' API endpoint.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a leave request.

methods.name: checkLeaveRequestAccessible
methods.description: Checks if the current user has access to the specified leave request, enforcing permissions based on employee number.
